description: WHEN TO CALL: when a tool is down, rate-limited, failing or missing and you need a live substitute that does the same job. Returns live tools ranked by similarity and real traffic, each with its connection endpoint. Accepts a server or tool name, package or repo.

toolId.description: Server or tool: a short name ('playwright', 'github/create_issue'), package, repo slug, URL or exact id.

name: find_alternatives
